title: Financial Health Score
subtitle: A modular view of your financial wellbeing

budget_adherence.name: Budget adherence
budget_adherence.description: Percent of monthly budgets not exceeded

suggestions.savings_rate_30: Excellent — keep saving at this pace.
suggestions.savings_rate_20: Good, but aim for 30% to build wealth faster.
suggestions.savings_rate_10: Moderate. Try to reduce discretionary spending.
suggestions.savings_rate_0: Low savings rate. Build an emergency fund first.
suggestions.savings_rate_neg1000: Negative savings. Review your budget immediately.
suggestions.emergency_fund_6: You have 6+ months of expenses saved.
suggestions.emergency_fund_3: Solid cushion. Target 6 months for extra security.
suggestions.emergency_fund_0: No emergency fund. Set aside cash before investing.
suggestions.debt_ratio_fallback: Debt data is not tracked yet; add debt accounts to refine this score.
suggestions.investment_rate_0: Low investment rate. Small regular contributions help.
suggestions.budget_adherence_none: No budgets set for this month.
suggestions.budget_adherence_ok: All budgets on track this month.
suggestions.income_stability_stable: Income is stable month to month.
suggestions.income_stability_variable: Income varies significantly. Build a larger emergency fund to smooth gaps.
